title: Scene Link Rubber Band Setxyz Na N Fix
description: Fix SceneLinkRubberBand setXYZ calls missing z argument causing NaN BufferGeometry and failing scene Playwright console checks.
summary: Scene Playwright failed: console contained THREE.BufferGeometry computeBoundingSphere NaN from SceneLinkRubberBand idle branch calling setXYZ with only three coordinates (z was undefined). Fixed to setXYZ(i,0,0,0) for both vertices. Vitest + Playwright (3 e2e) pass.
